title: FirstPaycheck extracted fields
description: The contract between Documents and retrieval (which writes it) and the financial engine and app (which read it). One file per ingest run. Draft 0.1, built from the Appendix A inputs until the engine's field list arrives. Quiz answers (filing status, city, who is covered, emergency fund, loans, savings goal) are not document fields and are not in here.

value.description: Typed by unit: number for usd_* / percent / months, string for date (YYYY-MM-DD) and enum, boolean for boolean, array of tiers for match_tiers.

plan.description: Health plan name as the guide writes it, e.g. "HDHP with HSA". Only on health.* fields.

coverage_tier.description: Only on health.* fields whose amount depends on who is covered.

doc.description: File name of the source document, e.g. benefits_guide.pdf.

page.description: 1-based page the value was read from; the app links to get_page(doc, page).

source_text.description: The redacted line the value came from, shown on the confirmation screen.

status.description: Every field starts unconfirmed. No calculator runs on an unconfirmed field.

oneOf.description: enum: weekly | biweekly | semimonthly | monthly. Offer letter. Example 1.
date. Offer letter. Sets the first check and the enrollment window.
enum: hdhp | ppo | hmo | epo. Benefits guide, one per plan. Example 2.
usd_per_paycheck, employee share. Benefits guide, per plan and coverage tier. Example 2.
usd_per_year. Benefits guide, per plan and coverage tier. Example 2.
usd_per_year. Benefits guide, per plan and coverage tier. Needed for Example 2's high-use year.
usd_per_year. Benefits guide, HSA-eligible plans only, per coverage tier. Example 2.
match_tiers: [{"match_percent": 100, "up_to_percent_of_pay": 6}], one entry per tier. Benefits guide. Examples 3 and 5.
boolean: price is the lower of offering start and purchase date. Benefits guide. Example 4.
months, 0 when there is none. Benefits guide. Example 4's hard case.
percent of pay. Benefits guide. Example 4's dollar gain.
date. Benefits guide. The app's deadline checklist.
usd_per_paycheck. Pay stub. Cross-checks salary / pay frequency in Example 1.
date. Pay stub. Cross-checks pay frequency.

fields.name: offer.annual_salary
fields.source_text: Your starting annual base salary will be $90,000.
